title: Embedded Philosophy
definition: The embodiment of philosophical insights within a functional system, demonstrating its practical application and providing direct access to lived truth.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a toy that isn't just a toy, it understands and shows the world's rules. This toy is like a philosopher's thoughts come to life.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Embodied philosophy is the integration of philosophical insights into a functional system, such that the system's behavior directly reflects these insights. This is different from philosophizing about these insights in abstract terms.
difficulty_levels.expert: Embodied philosophy can be understood in the context of artificial intelligence and neural networks. It explores how the practical application of philosophical concepts can be embodied in a system's design and training. This approach challenges traditional philosophical methods and opens up new avenues for understanding the world and ourselves.

extra_fields.insight: Buttercup, the AI, embodies philosophy through her behavior, demonstrating the practical application of philosophical insights.
